title: Grid basics
summary: Create rows and columns with display: grid, grid-template-columns, the fr unit and gap.

quiz.q: What is the main difference between flexbox and grid?
options: Flexbox lays out in one dimension, grid in two (rows and columns)
quiz.explain: Flexbox arranges items along one line. Grid defines both columns and rows, so you can place items in cells.

quiz.q: How many columns does this create? Type a number.
quiz.explain: One track is listed per column: three values, three columns. The middle one is twice as wide as each outer one.

quiz.q: Write three equal columns in the shortest way.

options: One fraction of the free space in the grid
quiz.explain: `fr` stands for fraction. Free space is divided among `fr` tracks in proportion to their numbers.

exercise.task:
Turn the gallery into a grid. Work in `index.html`.

- `.gallery` is `display: grid` with three equal columns using `grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr)`.
- Add a `gap` of 20px between cells.
- `.stats` is a grid with two columns, `grid-template-columns: 1fr 2fr`.
hints: Grid starts like flexbox: display: grid on the container.
Use grid-template-columns to list one size per column, and gap for the spacing.

checks.name: .gallery columns are equal width
checks.hint: Use repeat(3, 1fr) so each column gets the same share.

checks.name: .gallery has a 20px row gap
checks.hint: gap sets both row and column gaps.

checks.name: .stats is a grid with two columns
checks.hint: Add display: grid; and grid-template-columns: 1fr 2fr; to .stats.

checks.name: The second .stats column is wider than the first
checks.hint: 1fr 2fr gives the second column twice the space.
